label: Higher at D1 after an a2 choice, at D2 when S2 is reached; lower after no reward.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (ep_trial % 10) * (ep_dec == 9)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 9 sits near 0.9 early in the episode and drops sharply over the last ~20 trials. Timing alone gives R^2 0.86. Beyond timing, it carries the current action/state identity: at D1 it is higher after the agent chose a2 (and lower after a1, especially after an unrewarded a1, most of all a1->S2 unrewarded), and at D2 it is higher when S2 is reached than when S1 is reached. A smaller version of the a2 effect persists at GO. The observer belief_lo adds little once the previous choice is included. The free fit adds the a1-unrewarded interaction, the GO term, a D2 a1-S2-unrewarded correction and a within-decile slope over the last 10 trials (about 0.05 of the variance). Large persistent per-window offsets late in the episode stay unexplained. No future variables are used.
